sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fees"."orderslink" AS e, "orders"."timespan" AS g, AVG((CAST("fees"."rebrate" AS REAL) / "fees"."feerate")) AS m1 FROM "fees" JOIN "orders" ON "orders"."recordvault" = "fees"."orderslink"  GROUP BY "fees"."orderslink", "orders"."timespan"), "s2" AS (SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, AVG("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1" GROUP BY "s1"."g"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, ("s1"."m1" - "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s1"."g" = "s2"."g"), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m1") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m1" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s3"."m1" > "s4"."v"), "s6" AS (SELECT "s5"."g" AS g, AVG("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5" GROUP BY "s5"."g") SELECT AVG("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
